route_status.proven_scope: The exact Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf headless probe_interaction passed at the frozen baseline, with isolated save profile and no failure lines. It checks assisted travel intent/manual override, live touch-interactable inventory and affordances, navigation/room actions, overlay control blocks, transition cleanup, and Classic-mode rollback.
route_status.route_gaps: The probe sets Hybrid mode and invokes _tap_move_ref().start(), _on_touch_manual_move(), _on_touch_world(), room methods, and other game methods directly. It does not synthesize InputEventScreenTouch/InputEventScreenDrag or establish a visible screen-to-handler tap/drag route. No rendered Mobile view, real phone, observed child, or full natural route was reviewed.

code_constants.scope: Hybrid movement begins after drag exceeds 22 px; stick magnitude is clamped over the 78 px radius. These are code thresholds, not measured phone geometry.

code_constants.value: Probe waits: 2 initial frames, 8 frames after intro skip, 24 frames on promenade; Engine.time_scale = 4.0
code_constants.scope: Scripted setup/settling only. It does not measure child play duration or displayed-frame response.

timing.assumptions: No gameplay-duration estimate inferred. The helper's 37.228-second wall time is probe execution time, not a play session.

tactile.target_size: The broad Hybrid movement zone is the lower-left 48% of screen height and max(390 px, 34% of screen width) (scripts/touch_ui.gd:315-326); an unmoved press there still becomes a world tap on release (scripts/touch_ui.gd:272-286). These are canvas coordinates, not physical millimetres or a demonstrated touch target. The probe does not measure visible target size or neighboring-target separation.
tactile.press_response: Source routes Hybrid world taps on release and flashes at the release/press coordinate (scripts/touch_ui.gd:688-722); the integration probe did not send a pointer event or verify a rendered response within two frames.
tactile.drag_hold_release: A Hybrid world press is assigned WORLD_INTERACT and passed to world_press_probe on down; exceeding 22 px marks it WORLD_MOVE, a consumed press's own drag cancels its charge, release calls the consumed press's release callback, while an unconsumed unmoved release emits world_touched (scripts/touch_ui.gd:688-740). This lifecycle is source-confirmed, not physically exercised by L32.
tactile.ownership: Touch owner is indexed per finger; the stick begins only when no stick finger is active, while other touches can own WORLD_INTERACT. The source keeps each pending world press with its original index and removes its pending entry on release (scripts/touch_ui.gd:688-740). No multi-finger event was fed by this probe.
tactile.cancellation: Touch-state reset clears state (scripts/touch_ui.gd:543-553, 602-603); main wires press/release/drag/cancel callbacks (scripts/main.gd:3801-3813), and pause/focus teardown is governed by broader input lifecycle code. L32 does not drive focus loss or prove real-device cancellation.

play_appeal.agency: Hypothesis: letting a deliberate tap in the lower-left thumb bay still act on the painted world, while a longer directional drag steers, may make the control grammar forgiving. The test did not experience that response through touch.
play_appeal.variety: The source distinguishes world tap, stick travel, consumed press/charge, and swipe paths; L32 focuses routing/ownership and does not establish how varied or appealing those verbs feel to a child.
play_appeal.world_response: Code routes enemy hit engines before the interaction director, and the promenade receives tap/drag coordinates (scripts/main.gd:4587-4635; touch drag routing at scripts/main.gd:4563-4585). No visual/audio response was observed in this headless review.
play_appeal.replay: Not assessed. The probe returns from a room/Level 2 through scripted method calls, not a child's replay choice.

play_sequence.input: On a Hybrid gameplay screen, touch an open lower-left point and lift without moving.
play_sequence.wait: No minimum hold; release is the routing edge.

play_sequence.input: Tap a visible world destination outside the movement bay, then lift at the same point.
play_sequence.wait: No tap-duration gate in Hybrid WORLD_INTERACT release path.

play_sequence.input: Press in the lower-left movement bay, drag 23 px in one direction, then lift.
play_sequence.wait: One drag event beyond TAP_SLOP = 22.0 px; no probe-verified duration.

play_sequence.input: While the first world finger is down, place a second finger on a different world point; move/lift only the second finger, then lift the first.
play_sequence.wait: One second-finger down/move/up sequence; exact multitouch latency is unmeasured.
play_sequence.grounding: scripts/touch_ui.gd:688-740; L32 does not execute these events.

play_sequence.input: Press an enemy target and hold; then either lift in place or drag that same finger beyond 22 px before lifting.
play_sequence.wait: Compare release-in-place with one over-threshold drag; source has no gameplay-time value for charge completion in this probe.

play_sequence.input: After establishing a held movement/charge, invoke pause or background the app, resume, then tap a destination once.
play_sequence.wait: One pause/focus transition and one post-resume tap; L32 did not run this sequence.

observations.title: Hybrid press ownership separates world tap, movement, and consumed action
evidence: scripts/touch_ui.gd:688-722 assigns a finger to ACTION, STICK, or WORLD_INTERACT; an unconsumed unmoved world release emits world_touched, while a consumed press gets its paired release callback.
scripts/touch_ui.gd:723-740 changes a world finger to WORLD_MOVE only after movement exceeds TAP_SLOP and cancels only its own consumed charge.
scripts/touch_ui.gd:92-94 sets TAP_SLOP to 22.0 px and stick radius R to 78.0 px.
observations.reproduction: Source trace only; the L32 probe does not feed raw touch or drag events.
observations.child_impact: If event ownership behaves as written, simple one-finger taps and drags can keep distinct meanings. Physical latency, hit feel, multi-finger rejection, and accidental ownership remain unverified.
observations.proposed_repair: No source repair inferred. Validate the present one-finger ownership grammar on the target phone before changing it.
observations.acceptance_test: On the exact candidate and phone, record one-finger world tap, movement drag, consumed hold/release, same-finger drag cancellation, second-finger interference, pause, and focus-loss. Confirm each gesture triggers only its owned action and no stale action fires.

observations.title: The lower-left thumb bay preserves a tap when it never becomes a drag
evidence: scripts/touch_ui.gd:315-326 defines the lower-left movement zone and explicitly returns an empty zone while encounter press owns input.
scripts/touch_ui.gd:272-286 emits a Hybrid world tap on an unmoved stick-zone release; _rest_stick hides the visual stick at :292-303.
scripts/probe_interaction.gd:55-63 checks assisted steering intent and manual override, but uses _tap_move_ref().start() and _on_touch_manual_move() directly.
observations.reproduction: Code inspection and probe inspection. L32 confirms manual override state after direct method calls, but does not prove that a child-visible tap in this region reaches the intended destination.
observations.child_impact: This design may allow an imprecise tap to work in the broad thumb bay, but a hidden region may still feel surprising if a short touch is interpreted differently than a drag; child discoverability was not observed.
observations.proposed_repair: Keep the broad bay behavior unless routed touch observation shows it steals or misroutes visible world actions; avoid adding another visible control legend based only on this source review.
observations.acceptance_test: On device, compare a short release and a clear >22 px directional drag at three lower-left positions and one point outside the bay. Verify the same visible object receives a tap everywhere, while only the drag steers; check the child can discover the distinction without explanation.

observations.title: Integration probe passes but reaches travel through internal method calls
evidence: audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L32/attempt_1/receipt.json: status PASS, exact engine Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf, frozen baseline, isolated save profile, exit_code 0, no failure lines.
scripts/probe_interaction.gd:29-41 instantiates the game, skips intro, sets Hybrid mode, and repopulates interactables; :55-63 starts assisted movement and invokes manual override directly.
scripts/probe_interaction.gd:735 directly calls _on_touch_world during a transition; no InputEventScreenTouch or InputEventScreenDrag is constructed in this probe.
observations.reproduction: Rerun only under a separately authorized study invocation; this assigned L32 invocation already passed once. Inspect probe setup/calls and receipt/log to see the exact scope.
observations.child_impact: The pass supports state/routing policy and cleanup at method level; a broken input event route could still prevent a child from reaching those methods naturally.
observations.proposed_repair: Do not modify the passing probe to simulate coverage it does not have. Collect a routed-input trace and physical-device play evidence as separate lanes.
observations.acceptance_test: Capture an actual one-finger trace from an ordinary gameplay screen through tap-to-world, drag travel, release, and retarget on the intended phone; bind the trace to the exact candidate and confirm visible response, no stuck motion, and child comprehension without adult help.

observations.title: Main binds press, release, drag, and cancellation to distinct world handlers
evidence: scripts/main.gd:3801-3813 connects world_touched/manual movement and assigns press, release, drag, swipe, and cancellation callables.
scripts/main.gd:4469-4501 press-probes Melody, Slide Race, then priority enemies; :4503-4518 releases held charges.
scripts/main.gd:4531-4549 changes a travelling press-fired finger from charge to drag; :4550-4561 cancels held charge without firing.
scripts/main.gd:4563-4585 routes unconsumed promenade drags or combat swipes; :4587-4635 gives enemies forefront priority before interaction fallback.
observations.reproduction: Static route trace; the runtime probe does not exercise these handlers with pointer events or inspect two-frame rendered feedback.
observations.child_impact: Distinct handler ownership can prevent one gesture from accidentally becoming both an attack and a swipe. Incorrect coordinates or delayed visual confirmation could still make the interaction feel unresponsive.
observations.proposed_repair: No code change proposed from the current evidence; preserve the single-gesture ownership and verify rendered feedback/phone input separately.
observations.acceptance_test: On device, bind touch event coordinates to visible enemy/prop/promenade targets; verify one press-release yields at most one verb, a same-finger drag cancels its charge, and a miss causes no unintended world movement or action.

strengths.claim: The exact-build probe passes assisted travel steering intent and explicit manual override checks.
strengths.evidence: scripts/probe_interaction.gd:55-63; audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L32/attempt_1/probe.log:3 reports INTERACTION|ALL OK. This is direct method/state evidence, not routed input.

strengths.claim: The source gives each Hybrid finger an owner and carries consumed press release/cancel semantics through separate callbacks.
strengths.evidence: scripts/touch_ui.gd:688-740; scripts/main.gd:3801-3813, 4503-4561. Not phone or child verification.

strengths.claim: The same broad lower-left zone permits a short world tap and directional steering drag rather than making a hidden-stick touch bay a dead zone.
strengths.evidence: scripts/touch_ui.gd:272-286, 315-326. This claim is code behavior only; rendered discoverability is open.

acceptance_gaps: No raw routed touch/drag input was executed in L32; probe state is set directly and gameplay handlers are invoked directly.
No Mobile-rendered capture, physical target-size measurement, latency or frame-pacing evidence.
No intended Android phone hold/drag/multitouch/focus-loss/pause/re-entry evidence; MA-TOUCH-001 remains FIXED_PENDING_VERIFICATION.
No observed-child comprehension, comfort, discoverability, agency, session-duration or appeal evidence.
The probe's 37.228-second runner time is not play duration; no fun score assigned.
